dict.Plicul PDF-ului e criptat cu RC2 cu o lu: The PDF's envelope is encrypted with RC2 using an unknown key length.
dict.Plicul PDF-ului e criptat cu un algoritm: The PDF's envelope is encrypted with an algorithm Cyber Office Studio does not know.
dict.Certificatul are o cheie EC pe o curbă n: The certificate has an EC key on an unknown curve: the PDF can be encrypted for the P-256, P-384 and P-521 curves.
The certificate does not have an RSA key.
dict.Plicul PDF-ului folosește pentru cheia E: The PDF's envelope uses a scheme for the EC key that Cyber Office Studio does not know.
